crosswalks.label: Information Security Analysts
crosswalks.rationale: Information security risk/control work grounds part of security architecture but does not define the architecture profession.

crosswalks.label: Secure Systems Development
crosswalks.rationale: NICE secure-systems work provides design context; AXM Security Architect remains a bounded synthesis profession rather than a NICE job mapping.

findings.summary: Security Architecture must keep design intent, control selection, implementation evidence and residual-risk acceptance as separate authority/evidence layers.
findings.rationale: Research-backed boundary is compiled into package-local machinery.

gaps_against_body.description: Make architecture-versus-implementation proof and risk-acceptance boundaries explicit.

nonclaims: No complete Security Architect reconstruction is claimed.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No technical access, package construction, role label, model capability or repository permission creates legal, security, safety, privacy, risk, product or institutional authority.
